transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As you know, next week we need to recertify both our Alpha and Bravo vehicle-operator cohorts. We've got two four-hour blocks available in the training area: Monday 0800-1200 and Tuesday 1300-1700. Each cohort needs its own dedicated evaluator, and that evaluator has to be listed on the training schedule. Before I publish the final schedule, I want to make sure we get all our coordination sorted out in this huddle. Who do we have available as evaluators, and are there any conflicts I should know about with either the Monday or Tuesday block?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I checked the training database this morning — the only evaluator currently authorized for the Alpha cohort is Sgt. Lewis, and he's available Monday 0800-1200. The evaluator roster hasn't been attached to the weekly schedule yet, so we need to make sure Sgt. Lewis gets listed on the schedule for that block.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Capt. Morgan, I need to flag a conflict. I confirmed the bay booking today — Bravo's assigned vehicles are booked for preventive maintenance Monday afternoon and Tuesday morning. That means Bravo can only train during the Tuesday 1300-1700 block, after the motor pool releases them. The maintenance calendar hasn't been cross-referenced with the training schedule yet, so this hasn't been captured in our planning.
transcript.speaker: A3
